promptRules: Pot is a static portfolio site deployed on Vercel. There is no package.json and no build step. Do not add one, and do not add any dependency, framework, font or animation library.
Never change vercel.json, .vercelignore or anything under .github/ or scripts/.
Do not change the homepage (Chun Hee - Portfolio.dc.html), process.dc.html or work.dc.html unless the issue names that page.
Write PR descriptions and comments in Simplified Chinese, in plain words. Keep code, file names and error text in English.
Keep the change as small as the issue needs.
